payment.title: Payment help
payment.intro: Answers to the most common payment questions. Your server can help with anything else.

sections.heading: My payment failed
sections.body: If money left your account but the order didn’t go through, it’s returned automatically within 5–7 working days. You can try again or choose to pay at the counter.

sections.heading: Refunds
sections.body: When an item paid online is cancelled, we refund it to the original payment method. The order shows “Refund started” until it reaches you.

sections.heading: Paying the balance
sections.body: Request the bill and your server will bring it to the table. You can pay by {paymentMethods}.

sections.heading: Invoices
sections.body: Ask your server for a {taxInvoice} when you request the bill.

faqs.title: Allergens & FAQs
faqs.intro: Good to know while you’re with us.

sections.heading: Allergens and ingredients
sections.body: Each dish page lists its main ingredients and dietary tags. Tell your server about any allergy before you order — the kitchen can adjust most dishes.
